notes: Sides: just inside the inner straight rule that runs inside the thick bar. The frame bows (right side up to ~14 px off a straight corner-to-corner line, bottom rule kinks between x 350 and 900), so points were added along every side where the rule was measured on 8x crops. Corners now follow the inner arc, per the owner (README rule 2): at each corner the edge runs ~3 px inside the inner edge of the innermost (thin) arc, points every ~15-30 px, joining the side rule where the arc merges into it; the arcs, the corner-triangle ink and everything between them and the corner are outside. The small step in the bottom rule at x~350 is the bottom-left arc's tail. Blocks on the left run right up to the inner rule and cross the bottom-left arc; the edge keeps the rule outside and cuts the blocks at the arc. The ZONE MAP title/legend block (bottom right) and the BAY OF SAN FRANCISCO lettering float over the map with no rule and stay inside (README rule 4).
